rule.description: Detects every call that attaches a starter-template convention fragment to the shared template-rule registry (registerTemplateRule, including import-aliased and namespace-qualified forms). Convention fragments registered from more than one module mean the template-convention policy has no single owner: a conceptual change to any convention must be made in several source and configuration files at once. Registrations confined to a single module are accepted as a consolidated owner.

checks.description: A call to the shared registry's registration API attaches a named convention fragment from a module other than the registry itself, jointly assembling the starter-template convention policy across several modules.
checks.detected_relation: template-convention fragment -> shared template-rule registry (registerTemplateRule call site)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each registration call site contributes one piece of the same conceptual policy - where template data lives and how templates are classified - from whatever module its author edited. With registrations in four modules plus per-script settings.json slot maps selecting the fragments by string name, editing any single convention requires finding and synchronizing every participating file, which is exactly the scattered-responsibility problem the consolidation check looks for.

matches.evidence: registerTemplateRule("template.properties.join", propertiesPathFor) wires the companion-metadata path convention in from a helper module; the validation sweep and the GHES properties require/checkout list resolve it through the properties-path slot keys of two different settings files.
registerTemplateRule("template.workflow.join", workflowPathFor) registers the workflow-file location convention from the same helper module; only the GHES sweep consumes it.
registerTemplateRule("icons.ref.octicon-prefix", iconRefIsOcticon) registers the validation pass's whitespace-anchored embedded-icon recognition from a second helper module.

registerTemplateRule("icons.ghes.kind", ghesIconIsEmbedded) registers the GHES prefix-anchored icon-kind flavor alongside the validation flavor of the same concept, so the convention exists twice in different modules.
registerTemplateRule("icons.path.repo-svg", svgIconPath) registers the local svg icon location convention consumed by both the validation existence access and the GHES icon copy list.

registerTemplateRule("icons.ref.token", octiconNameFromRef) registers the embedded icon token extraction from the icon helper module; the validation pass depends on it to accept or reject octicon references.

registerTemplateRule("template.blank.suffix", isBlankTemplate) leaves the blank-template exemption rule defined and registered inside the validation entry point itself rather than with the other convention fragments.
registerTemplateRule("folders.deployments.name", isDeploymentFolder) leaves the deployments-folder classification rule inside the validation entry point, next to the creator requirement it feeds.

registerTemplateRule("partners.creator.match", isPartnerCreator) defines the partner-creator classification inside the GHES entry point while importing the validation script's helper modules to trigger their registrations first.

registerTemplateRule("folders.code-scanning.name", isCodeScanningFolder) defines the enterprise-only folder classification inside the GHES entry point, spreading the folder taxonomy across both scripts.

excluded.reason: The registry module declares the registration API and lookup table the fragments attach to. It is the coupling mechanism of the scattered fragments, not itself a dispersed convention fragment, so the rule reports the registration call sites rather than the registry file.
